description: ALWAYS CALL THIS FIRST for any cost question. Runs a fixed, deterministic chain and returns one payload containing: the active Chargeback configuration (rate, currency, weights); the deployment inventory with each deployment classified as hosted or serverless; cost per deployment; and provisioned-versus-realized capacity with utilization. Because the chain is fixed, the platform classification is always present, so you never have to guess whether a deployment is Serverless. Use the narrower chargeback.* tools only to drill into a specific deployment afterwards. days = lookback window in days, default 30.
